name: Line Formation
description: Standard combat line providing balanced frontline melee engagement.

name: Shield Wall
description: Tight interlocking shields providing heavy armor, ranged defense, and full cavalry charge negation.

name: Wedge
description: Triangular shock formation maximizing charge impact velocity and penetration.

name: Square / Box
description: All-round defense preventing flanking penalties and protecting inner ranks.

name: Loose / Skirmish
description: Dispersed layout minimizing casualties from incoming projectile barrages.

name: Column / Travel
description: Marching formation for rapid repositioning across roadways, vulnerable to ambushes.
